verdict.rationale: React ships a full set of official, first-party SDK-style APIs and packages for building against it — react-dom (createRoot/hydrateRoot), react-native for mobile, official TypeScript types, and framework integrations (Next.js/React Router) documented on react.dev, plus an official GitHub repo. missing for 10: no AI-agent-specific SDK or explicit 'agentic' integration guidance, only general TypeScript/platform SDKs.
